annotation.title_clean: 人力资源社会保障部 国家发展改革委 工业和信息化部 国家数据局关于加快推进“人工智能＋人社”应用发展的实施意见
annotation.title_en: Implementation Opinions of MOHRSS, NDRC, MIIT and National Data Administration on Accelerating the Application and Development of "AI + Human Resources and Social Security"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 人力资源社会保障部; 国家发展改革委; 工业和信息化部; 国家数据局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial implementation opinions promoting AI applications in human resources and social security: sector large models, agents, datasets, platforms, standards, funding and security safeguards, with targets for 2026, 2027 and 2030. Contains one passing provision encouraging humanoid robots and embodied intelligence for human-machine collaborative employment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets: ~20 AI scenarios by 2026, ~50 high-value scenarios by 2027, mature sector large models by 2030
Build national AI platform with 1+N+32 structure and sector datasets and corpora
Establish AI employment impact assessment and survey system
Provinces encourage humanoid robots and embodied AI products to explore human-machine collaborative employment
Security safeguards: data classification, risk early warning, emergency response and AI ethics governance
